description: Schedule a post to one connected social account. Call list_connected_accounts first to get a valid socialAccountId — post to multiple platforms by calling this once per account.

firstComment.description: Optional first comment posted immediately after publishing (Facebook and Instagram only)

mediaUrl.description: A publicly accessible image or video URL to attach, if any

scheduledFor.description: ISO 8601 timestamp for when to post — use the current time for immediate posting

socialAccountId.description: The connected account id to post to, from list_connected_accounts

name: schedule_post
